subject: Evaluation charter + weekly gate plan — Summit Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Powell <alex.powell@summitanalytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation charter + weekly gate plan — Summit Analytics

Alex — thanks for the call earlier. Short recap and a proposed path forward so we’re aligned before the kickoff: 

1) Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
   - Inference latency: median < 350ms for typical queries (50-100 token prompts)
   - Throughput: sustained 10 reqs/sec during peak simulation window
   - Output fidelity: top-line intent extraction >= 92% on your labeled sample set
   - Cost target: baseline token cost <= $0.0025/token for the trial workload

2) Proposed milestones (high level):
   - Week 0 (Prep): data access + test dataset delivery, security questionnaire, SSO test account
   - Week 1–2 (Integration): model routing + KV cache validation, small-scale load testing
   - Week 3–4 (Validation): acceptance benchmarks, edge-case checks, final readout

3) Ownership (our side):
   - Integration & infra: Jonas Weber (SE)
   - Commercial/contract: Sergio Alvarez (AE)
   - Project lead: me (Marissa)

4) Next steps for you:
   - Confirm the success criteria above (or suggest edits)
   - Confirm availability for a kickoff on Tue Dec 7 (30–45m)
   - Share primary technical contact for dataset access and any IP constraints

I’ve attached an initial evaluation charter and a weekly gate plan (v1) to give a bit more structure. If this looks good I’ll send calendar invites and lock in owners.

Thanks — looking forward to running this together.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-8132

Attachments: summit_eval_charter_v1.pdf, summit_weekly_gate_plan_v1.xlsx

From: Alex Powell <alex.powell@summitanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@summitanalytics.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation charter + weekly gate plan — Summit Analytics

Marissa — thanks for the tidy recap. We’re aligned on most of this; a few clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: the fidelity target looks good but can we make it ">= 90%" on the first pass with a stretch goal to 92% after tuning? That will help us set realistic expectations for the validation window.
- Cost target: internal finance wants a short note on expected token volumes (I can share ballpark numbers today).
- Kickoff: Tue Dec 7 at 10:00am PT works for Priya and me.
- Data access: our infra team will provision a secure S3 bucket and an API key; primary technical contact is Ravi Mehta (ravi.mehta@summitanalytics.com). He’ll need a short integration checklist.

Security/compliance: our legal has already started the security questionnaire. They asked whether Redwood can provide SOC 2 report and basic data retention details in the next 48 hours — I know you have that standard pack but wanted to flag the ask.

We’re excited to get started. Can you send a calendar invite for Dec 7 and include an agenda?

—
Alex Powell
Director of Product | Summit Analytics
alex.powell@summitanalytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Powell <alex.powell@summitanalytics.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@summitanalytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation charter + weekly gate plan — Summit Analytics

Great — thanks Alex, that sounds sane. Quick updates and actions from our side: 

- Fidelity target: we’ll set the formal acceptance to >= 90% for initial validation, with a documented tuning plan to target 92% by the final readout. I added that to the charter (attached).
- Token volume note for finance: Jonas — can you draft a 1-paragraph estimate of expected tokens/day based on a 10 req/s peak with median prompt length ~80 tokens? I’ll forward to Alex.
- SOC2 & retention: Sergio will attach our SOC 2 summary and a short data-retention blurb in a single PDF (sending within 24h).
- Kickoff: I sent an invite for Tue Dec 7, 10:00–10:45am PT (calendar link included). Agenda: 1) Introductions & access plan, 2) Data and infra handoff, 3) Milestone review & acceptance criteria, 4) Next week’s integration tasks.

Attachments included in this thread: summit_eval_charter_v1.pdf (updated), summit_weekly_gate_plan_v1.xlsx, summit_sow_draft.docx (commercial draft). Please review and mark any items you want to change during kickoff.

Next immediate steps (summary):
- Alex / Ravi: share S3 access and point-of-contact for integration
- Alex / Legal: transmit SOC 2 request items to Sergio (we’ll respond within 24h)
- Jonas: token volume estimate for finance

If all good I’ll treat Dec 7 kickoff as confirmed.

—
Marissa

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation charter + weekly gate plan — Summit Analytics (internal)

Quick internal note on infra and test sizing before we go live: 

- Token volume estimate (ballpark) based on 10 req/sec peak, median prompt+response ~120 tokens -> ~1.03M tokens/hour at peak; recommend we provision for 6 hours of peak testing across two heavy runs -> ~= 6.2M tokens total for integration + validation runs.
- Test dataset: ask Summit for a stratified sample of ~2k labeled examples across the 5 primary intents; that will give us decent statistical confidence for the 90% threshold.
- Workload: I’ll prepare a lightweight integration checklist (auth, sample payloads, streaming acceptance test) and upload to the shared drive by EOD. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_summit_eval (internal runbook will be in the folder).

I’ll also draft a short note for finance on the expected token spend to help justify the commercial terms.

—Jonas
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
